title: Claude review findings
description: Structured result of the automated PR review. Severity is an enum so a gate can key off it: without the schema the reviewer invents its own labels each run, which is fine for a comment and useless for a check.

findings.description: Every finding, including LOW. An empty array is a valid and useful result.

severity.description: Assigned by the rubric in review/rubric.md. A finding that cannot name its failing input, or quote the untrue executable claim (not a comment), is LOW.

file.description: Repository-relative path the finding is about.

line.description: Line the finding anchors to. Omit when it is about the file as a whole.

summary.description: One line, no markdown. This is what appears as a CI annotation on the diff.
